final: WITH combo_counts AS (SELECT t.tradekind, a.translink, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM advancedbehavior a JOIN transactionrecord tr ON tr.transreg = a.translink JOIN trader t ON t.tradereg = tr.trdref GROUP BY t.tradekind, a.translink), shares AS (SELECT tradekind, translink, cnt, 1.0 * cnt / SUM(cnt) OVER (PARTITION BY tradekind) AS share FROM combo_counts), scored AS (SELECT tradekind, cnt, share, AVG(share) OVER (PARTITION BY tradekind) AS avg_share FROM shares) SELECT tradekind, AVG(cnt) AS average_count, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - avg_share) AS average_margin FROM scored WHERE share > avg_share GROUP BY tradekind
